applicable_when: The kernel has ynumel=98304 and xnumel=512, but the launch grid is only (cdiv(512,8),)=64 blocks — a 1D grid that only parallelizes the X dimension. The entire Y dimension (98304 elements) is serialized within each block with YBLOCK=8, meaning each block loops over 98304/8=12288 Y-tiles sequentially. With only 64 blocks on a 132-SM GPU, most SMs sit idle (0.03 waves/SM). The fix is to make the grid 2D: grid_x=cdiv(xnumel,XBLOCK), grid_y=cdiv(ynumel,YBLOCK), so all tiles are dispatched in parallel. Adding @triton.autotune explores the best XBLOCK/YBLOCK/num_warps combination.
